## Feature Summary

A clear and concise description of the requested feature or improvement.

## Problem Statement

What problem or limitation does this proposal solve? (e.g. "Currently, calculating tiered volume rates requires custom application logic...")

## Proposed Solution

Describe your envisioned implementation, API signature, or workflow.

## Package / Architecture Area

- [ ] `@trivio.ink/core` (pure financial calculations)
- [ ] `@trivio.ink/node` (server SDK client)
- [ ] `@trivio.ink/react` (UI components)
- [ ] Documentation / Architecture
- [ ] Other

## Invariants & Compliance Considerations

- Does this maintain zero-float integer arithmetic?
- Does this preserve developer ownership of payment records?
- Does this avoid hardcoding confidential bank or merchant policies?
